items.label: - 6-Pack Plant Support Stakes with Perfect Dimensions
items.value: This set includes 6 half-round plant support stakes, each with a 13-inch diameter plant support ring, 16.7-inch upper steel tube, 14.8-inch threaded lower steel tube. These stakes for plants are ideal for most bushy plants (hydrangeas, peonies, roses, tomatoes), work as reliable plant supports, and double as garden borders to keep walkways clear.

items.label: - Heavy-Duty Steel Plant Support Ring & Stakes
items.value: Crafted with 0.24-inch thick steel tube (thicker than standard plant support stakes) and finished with a weather-resistant green powder coat, these plant support ring won’t bend, warp, or break easily. The sturdy structure ensures the plant supports stand firmly in soil, serving as durable plant stakes for outdoor plants and shielding your greenery from harsh outdoor conditions for long-term use.

items.label: - Interlockable Semi-Circular Plant Cage Design
items.value: Each plant support stake features specially crafted semi-circle ends for seamless interlocking, boosting sturdiness and expanding size—perfect for using as a peony cage or plant cage for larger plants. Simply slip the plant support around existing plants and pair two to form a full circle for firm fixation, preventing drooping from weight, wind, or rain without damaging stems/roots, and working as excellent support stakes for plants.

items.label: - Easy-to-Install Plant Supports Stakes
items.value: Twist the threaded upper and lower steel tubes of these plant support stakes together, then push the pointed bottom into the ground—no tools needed. Use alone as plant support for small plants or interlock multiple support stakes for plants to form custom shapes; stack neatly for compact storage when not in use, making them versatile plant stakes for outdoor plants.

items.label: - Complete Plant Support Kit with All Essentials
items.value: This kit includes 6 premium plant support stakes, 12 boxed steel extension tubes, and 164 feet of plant ties—everything you need for effective plant support. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, these plant support stakes combo cater to all your gardening needs; reach out for prompt assistance with any questions about plant supports.
